subject: Ousting Hegseth ‘priority No. 1’ if Democrats retake majority, Rep. Jason Crow says
posts:

Evidence: Sunday talk show, intelligence warnings on Iran, partisan targeting
#Aletheia #USPol

Rep. Crow claims ousting Hegseth is essential to protect U.S. service members from foreign threats and incompetent leadership.

The push leverages legitimate Middle East threats as a partisan electoral pre-requisite, weaponizing national security oversight for political gain.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.85, -0.90) — Reductive Constraint

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Partisan electoral goals are masked as urgent national defense mandates during active military warnings.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 11.2, Uncertainty z: 4)

Rep. Jason Crow stated on Face the Nation that ousting War Secretary Pete Hegseth is top priority if Democrats win the House, amid DNI warnings of Iranian lethal plotting.

The Bright Side:
Highlighting real intelligence reports regarding Iranian threats to U.S. military personnel abroad.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (military readiness) with WHO (partisan political control of the House committee).

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors deploy a smart selfish maneuver, leveraging genuine foreign threats as pretexts to rally partisan identity and capture legislative power.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated national security defense and actual partisan posturing, it plots a direct trajectory toward exclusive control.
Modal Dynamics: can be -> is not via Red Top.

The Unavoidable Truth: Foreign adversaries like Iran pose verified lethal threats to U.S. service members.

The Unavoidable Lie: Congressional committee priorities are driven purely by neutral national defense rather than partisan power grabs.

Alethekanon:
National security oversight is routinely subverted into partisan electoral framing. Real threats to troops become currency for congressional majority battles.

Awwthekanon:
Our service members face real danger overseas while political leaders trade barbs on Sunday morning television.

Brothekanon:
Another weekend talk show fight where troops are put in the middle of a Washington power struggle.

Spirithekanon:
"The words of the reckless are like sword thrusts, but the tongue of the wise brings healing." Proverbs 12:18 FAIL
Weaponizing troop safety for partisan leverage inflicts deep wounds on public trust.

Actual Article Body:
On Sunday’s broadcast of CBS’s “Face the Nation,” Rep. Jason Crow (D-CO) said “priority number one if we retake the majority, to make sure we oust” Secretary of War Pete Hegseth.

Partial transcript as follows:

MARGARET BRENNAN: I want to ask you about national security issues. The Director of National Intelligence, Jay Clayton, reported the U.S. received intelligence that Iran has substantially increased efforts to target U.S. personnel. Lethal plotting efforts was how he put it in a memo by the Iranians against U.S. citizens have reached advanced stages in the Middle East and other countries. You sit on the Intelligence Committee. We know that the U.S. has drawn down from some military bases, some diplomatic posts. What, if anything, can you tell us about this plot?

REP. JASON CROW: Well, Iran remains a danger. Pete Hegseth remains incompetent and is not doing what’s necessary to protect our service members, which is why he’s my priority number one if we retake the majority, to make sure we oust him from the Pentagon, because our service members actually deserve competent, serious, real leadership that will protect them and do the right thing. And they currently don’t have that. But what’s more is you know who is the primary supporter of Iran, who is providing intelligence and helping supply and provide targeting to Iran to kill Americans? Vladimir Putin and Russia. So, how about we talk about the fact that in the last two weeks you had Steve Witkoff go and sit across from Vladimir Putin and call him a humanitarian, and Donald Trump lifted and eased sanctions to provide tens of billions of dollars to the Russian war machine to try to kill Americans.That is- that is just beyond the pale, and- and Donald Trump needs to stop because he is putting our service members at risk, and Americans should be just beside themselves with this administration is doing.
